$comment: CI gate: `check:bundle --budget scripts/bundle-budget.json --enforce`. eagerBytes caps the code evaluated at plugin startup and moduleActivationBytes caps what each module loads when it starts; outputBytes and stylesBytes are ratchets on main.js and styles.css. Lower a limit as code shrinks; never raise one without a recorded reason.

eagerBudgetReason: 2026-10-29 合入后实测启动闭包 135082 字节、111 个输入，含高亮入口、任务清单和终端模块的清单元数据。页面、Runner 和 xterm 仍懒加载。上限 132 KiB。
stylesBudgetReason: 2026-10-29 按合入后的 27 个样式源重写 styles.css，实测 1436333 字节，仍低于 1408 KiB 上限。
moduleActivationBudgetReason: 2026-10-29 合入终端工作台后实测并按 KiB 向上取整：agent 1384588（Space、PTY、收件箱、备份）、automations 219910、notifications 21285、task 166930。其余模块未超过既有上限。
